title: Lyndon Johnson signing Medicare bill, with Harry Truman, July 30, 1965.jpg
description: President Lyndon B. Johnson signing the Medicare Bill at the Harry S. Truman Library in Independence, Missouri. Former president Harry S. Truman is seated at the table with President Johnson. The following are in the background (from left to right): Senator Edward V. Long, an unidentified man, Lady Bird Johnson, Senator Mike Mansfield, Vice President Hubert Humphrey, and Bess Truman.

title: Photograph of President Lyndon Johnson Speaking at the Signing Ceremony for the Elementary and Secondary Education Act at the Former Junction Elementary School, Johnson City, Texas - DPLA - 15999b2790377af8c2d1256fe4905d1e.jpg
description: This is a photograph of President Lyndon Johnson speaking at the signing ceremony for the Elementary and Secondary Education Act at the former Junction Elementary School, Johnson City, Texas. Original Caption: Seated at President Johnson's left are Lady Bird Johnson, Lynda Bird Johnson, Senator Carl Albert, Kate Deadrich Loney (the President's first school teacher), Senator Eugene McCarthy, and Admiral William Raborn.

title: 1996 -251-16A Beijing Coal Hill Park (5069079384).jpg
description:
The top of Coal Hill is a popular spot for the elderly to gather for group exercise.
Coal Hill (Jingshan Park) just north of the Forbidden City is an artificial hill created in the 15th century from the soil excavated (by hand!) to form the moats of the Imperial Palace and nearby canals.  An old rumor held that emperors hid a stash of coal here.
